name_error_minlength: The name must be at least {length} characters long.
name_error_maxlength: The name must be at most {length} characters long.
login_admin_introduction: First, create an admin user. You will be able to create more users at a later time.
login_admin_credentials_info: Keep your credentials safe! There is no way to recover the administrator credentials.
category_label_targetbalance: Set a Target Balance for this Category
category_not_archivable_balance: There are still {#sum/} left in this category. To archive it, the remaining amount must be {#required/}.
category_not_archivable_pending_transact: There are still pending transactions in this category. To archive it, all transactions must be validated.
category_archive_info: Hide categories you no longer need to keep your budget overview tidy. Archived categories can be restored at any time.
category_delete_info: Permanently remove a category you created by mistake or never used. Deletion is only possible while the category holds no money and no transaction references it.
category_not_deletable_balance: There are still {#sum/} left in this category. To delete it, the remaining amount must be {#required/}.
category_not_deletable_transactions: {count} transactions still reference this category — recategorize or remove them first.
category_delete_confirm_description: "{name}" will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
category_archive_description: Here you can find all your archived categories. You can restore them at any time to display them again in your budget overview and to be able to assign budgets to them again.
new_budget_description: A budget plan includes accounts, categories, and transactions. Create different budget plans to organise these elements separately. For example, you could create one budget plan for your personal finances and another one for your business finances.
new_account_description: An account is basically a representation of your actual account. Create one account per bank account, credit card, etc. Each transaction will be assigned an account later on.
account_placeholder_name: What should your account be called?
unassigned_breakdown_prose_positive: Money counts from the month it arrives; what later months need is already deducted.
unassigned_breakdown_prose_negative_posi: Through this month, more was allocated than came in.
unassigned_breakdown_prose_negative_rese: By {month}, more is allocated than is covered by then.
new_category_description: Categories are the different areas where you spend your money, such as shopping, rent, leisure, etc. Create categories to keep track of your spending.
transactions_pagination_page_size_label: How many transactions should be displayed per page?
transaction_filter_category_description: Only show transactions of selected categories.
invitation_dialog_description: {inviterName} wants to give you access to the budget plan {#b}{budgetName}{/b}.
admin_description: Add new users here. Users log in with username and password. The password is generated by the administrator (you) and shared with them. Users can change their username and password on their settings page. Only you can add or remove users.
admin_delete_user_confirm_description: This action cannot be undone. The user and all their data will be deleted.
admin_generated_password_description: Send the generated password to the user
budget_users_dialog_title: Who has access to this budget?
budget_users_dialog_description: As the creator, you can invite other users to collaborate on this budget.
budget_users_invite_warning: When you accept an invitation, you get access to the {#b}entire{/b} budget plan including its accounts, categories, transactions, etc.
budget_settings_description: Here you can change the name and currency of your budget.
form_error_unexpected: Could not be saved. Please try again.
error_category_not_archivable: This category cannot be archived: the remaining balance must be zero and all transactions must be validated.
error_category_not_deletable: This category cannot be deleted: the remaining balance must be zero and no transaction may reference it.
